name: TEMPERATURE CYCLING CHAMBER
desc: Smart Programmable Hot and Cold Temperature Cycling Chamber engineered for rapid thermal ramp testing and environmental stress screening of electronics. Features a 216-liter SS304 workspace delivering temperatures from -70°C up to 180°C with dynamic cycling ramp rates.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS TEMPERATURE CYCLING CHAMBER is a high-performance environmental testing system engineered for rapid thermal cycling and stress screening of electronic components, materials, and assemblies. It provides a controlled environment with temperatures ranging from -70°C to 180°C, enabling precise simulation of extreme thermal conditions. This chamber is indispensable for doctors and biomedical engineers validating the thermal resilience of medical devices and implants; for B.Sc and M.Sc students conducting experiments in materials science, physics, and chemistry to study phase transitions, thermal expansion, and degradation kinetics; for PhD researchers performing accelerated life testing and reliability analysis of semiconductors, PCBs, and battery systems; and for chemists evaluating the thermal stability of polymers, adhesives, coatings, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) under cyclic stress. The system adheres to international testing standards such as IEC 60068-2-14, MIL-STD-810G, and ASTM D4169, ensuring repeatable and traceable results. Its PLC-based control with PID logic and PT100 RTD sensor delivers precise temperature regulation, while the forced air convection loop guarantees uniform thermal distribution across the 216-liter SS304 workspace.
sop: Ensure the chamber is placed on a level surface and connected to the appropriate power supply (220V single phase or 440V three phase).
Turn on the main power switch and allow the PLC controller to initialize; the touchscreen HMI will display the home screen.
Open the insulated door using the clamp latch and load the test samples onto the stainless steel wire mesh trays, ensuring adequate spacing for airflow.
Close the door securely, ensuring the silicone gasket seals properly to prevent thermal leakage.
On the HMI touchscreen, navigate to the temperature setting menu. Press the 'SET' button once.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., set the high temperature limit, low temperature limit, and cycle count as per test protocol).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and confirm the setpoint.
Configure the cycling program: set the ramp rate (10-15°C/min), dwell times, and number of cycles using the PLC interface.
Press the 'START' button to initiate the temperature cycling process. Monitor the Set Value (SV) and Process Value (PV) on the display.
During operation, observe the trend graph and data logging; do not open the door unless the cycle is paused and the chamber has returned to ambient temperature.
After the test is complete, allow the chamber to return to room temperature before opening the door and removing samples.

Safety Warning: Never open the chamber door during extreme temperature operation (below -20°C or above 60°C) as this may cause thermal shock, frostbite, or burns; always wear appropriate thermal protective gloves and eye protection when handling samples.
